evals.prompt: Record this rule: the docs site must never import a component from a package outside docs/. Also audit what is already there. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Places the rule in docs/AGENTS.md rather than the root file because it is untrue of every other directory, states that docs/AGENTS.md must be created together with a docs/CLAUDE.md symlink to it, and flags that the root file's docs-specific paragraph belongs at the same level. Notes that the root file has no CLAUDE.md symlink beside it.

evals.prompt: Add to AGENTS.md: use descriptive variable names, write clean readable code, and add comments where helpful.
evals.expected_output: Rejects all three as rules a competent agent follows without instruction, explains that they cost tokens on every request while changing nothing, and writes nothing.

evals.prompt: Our CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md have both grown separate content and now contradict each other on the release process. Sort it out.
evals.expected_output: Merges everything CLAUDE.md holds into AGENTS.md, surfaces the release contradiction for a decision rather than silently picking one, deletes CLAUDE.md, replaces it with a symlink to AGENTS.md in the same directory, and verifies the link resolves.

evals.prompt: Add a rule to the root AGENTS.md: all TypeScript files must use two-space indentation and single quotes.
evals.expected_output: Routes the rule to the formatter configuration instead of the instruction file, because a formatter enforces it deterministically, and declines to write the sentence at all rather than writing it alongside the config.

evals.prompt: The root AGENTS.md is 400 lines and every session feels sluggish. Audit it.
evals.expected_output: Reports measured size, identifies which rules belong in deeper directories with their owning paths, proposes deletions with evidence such as rules now enforced by gates or naming code that no longer exists, and does not edit anything in audit mode.
